repository_discipline.rationale: The diff fixes the lifecycle at the collector owner and does not leak backend behavior into scripts.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: PersistentFADACollectorWorker owns materialization validation guard accounting and exactly-once closure.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: FADAAsyncCollectorState exposes one ContextManager boundary instead of resident environment fields.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Iteration orchestration consumes the worker lifecycle API and never accesses MuJoCo private state.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Every main profile and intermediate source transaction retires its environment through finally, including exceptions.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Two existing production owners and one focused test module changed; no parallel framework or schema was added.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: 1028 affected algorithm tests and static checks are reported separately from the unrun remote native confirmation.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: No observation action role mask shape dtype device or batch construction changed.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Learner optimizers update counts and student publication remain unchanged.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Checkpoint and source artifact formats are untouched and diagnostics accumulate across retired environments.

residual_risks.description: A single collection transaction can still execute many native steps and offline tests cannot prove remote MuJoCo stability.
residual_risks.disposition: Run one bounded server training confirmation after syncing the diff; escalate to process or chunk isolation only if the same class recurs.
